remarks:
Located just 3.5 miles south of Albion NY in Orleans County, this 72 acre wooded tract lies in the heart of big-buck country.

Properties of this caliber rarely become available in this sought-after area.

The property is located on East Lee Road, Route 31A, and features a long stone driveway leading to an excellent building site shown on the aerial map. This mature woodland includes trails, food plots, tree stands, and a large enclosed tree blind. The included photos demonstrate the area's proven record for producing large bucks, and the owner has managed the property specifically to support deer habitat.

The land is level and easy to walk. An extensive interior trail system crosses several small streams and waterways throughout the property.

The property is best viewed by UTV or ATV. The owner permits their use during scheduled appointments after a Hold Harmless Agreement is signed, provided the vehicles are operated responsibly and with respect for the land.
